summary: F0 final verification completed. Static/code checks, pytest, production build, public health endpoint, and dashboard flow were verified. Docker runtime was NOT VERIFIED because the docker executable is unavailable.
action_items: Fix frontend Docker runtime port alignment before claiming Compose runtime verification: frontend Dockerfile starts the dev server on 3000 while Compose maps host 3000 to container port 80.
critical_code_review_comments: Docker Compose backend DATABASE_URL embeds postgres credentials/database and does not derive them from the db service POSTGRES_* variables; custom Compose database credentials would make the backend unable to connect.

rca of the issue: Static Compose review found frontend ports are inconsistent: frontend/Dockerfile runs `yarn start` (CRA server on container port 3000), but Compose publishes `3000:80`, where no process listens. Compose also hardcodes DATABASE_URL credentials/database instead of interpolating POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, and POSTGRES_DB, so non-default db environment values are inconsistent with backend connectivity.
